title: How This Trader Makes 100%+ Returns with Double Calendar Spreads (Full Strategy)

NO transform-to-condor (contrast Bernich's DC Time Machine, same entry / opposite management). Claims >85% win, '$400k to $2M in 3 years', 'well over 100% annually' -- all account-level, no separable trade log, and the 'only this strategy' claim contradicts the 80/20 split. 'Negative-vega trick' hand-waved. Write-up: strategies/double_calendar_ravish.md (conviction 1.5/5).
